places.name: Gone Fishing

places.name: Gear Up
places.desc: Gear Up is the second main Story Mission in of Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise in Grand Theft Auto VI, and the third main Story Mission overall.

places.name: Just a Scratch
places.desc: Jason takes his Ganado to Coastal Auto Care for repairs and a respray, introducing the game's vehicle repair and customization mechanics.

places.name: Lab Fees
places.desc: Jason visits a local gift shop to collect overdue rent on behalf of Brian Heder, discovering that the business is involved in more than selling souvenirs.

places.name: Unwanted Attention
places.desc: Jason meets Cal while he is fishing, before the pair travel to a police impound in Hamlet to recover a vehicle. After stealing the car and attracting police attention, Jason must evade the authorities and return home.

places.name: Hey Arnold!
places.desc: Brian asks Jason and Cal to help locate Arnold, a former associate who has been avoiding him following problems with the Kingfishers. After confronting Arnold, Jason pursues him through the area and can choose whether to kill or spare him.

places.name: Island Dreams
places.desc: Jason accompanies Kenton on a scuba-diving excursion disguised as a bachelor party, searching a shipwreck for valuable items. When one of the divers becomes trapped underwater and a shark approaches the group, Jason must help resolve the situation before returning to the surface.

places.name: Feng Shui
places.desc: Cal visits Jason at his house and notices that he has been preparing for Lucia's return. The pair rearrange the furniture while discussing Jason's past relationship with Lucia and his plans for their future.

places.name: Coming Home
places.desc: Jason collects Lucia following her release from Hamlet Correctional and takes her to The Rusty Anchor, where she reunites with her former prison acquaintance Kat and meets Mattia. During the evening, Jason becomes involved in a fight with members of the Aviators, forcing him and Lucia to flee from the police.

places.name: Clean Up After Donnie
places.desc: Following another unsuccessful drug delivery, Donnie loses a package in the Grassrivers. Cal locates its signal, allowing Jason to retrieve the drugs from a group of fishermen before delivering them to Donnie's trailer.

places.name: Buck Me
places.desc: Lucia asks Jason for his banking information, only to discover that he does not have a bank account. The pair visit a local Fleeca branch, where Jason's poor credit history prevents him from opening an account. They are instead introduced to the BuckMe application.

places.name: Down to Earth
places.desc: Brian summons Jason to his marina for another cocaine delivery involving a new broker. Lucia accompanies Jason in a Dodo seaplane, but the arrangement turns into a shootout when the broker fails to pay the dealers. After returning home, Lucia must explain her absence to her probation officer.

places.name: Clear Skies
places.desc: Brian orders Jason to supervise Donnie during another smuggling operation near Southwind and Mile Zero Air Station. After helping a pilot land undetected, Donnie secretly arranges a deal with The Devil's Dozen, who take him hostage. Jason must rescue him before the pair escape.

places.name: Day Release
places.desc: Jason and Lucia meet Kat and Mattia at The Rusty Anchor before joining them aboard Mattia's yacht. Lucia participates in a Seashark race, and the group later travels to Vice City, where Jason and Lucia drive a Zorrusso and visit a hotel and NINE1NINE. Mattia subsequently offers the pair a job worth $10,000.

places.name: Swamped
places.desc: Brian takes Jason to a Kingfishers camp to settle their ongoing dispute, where they discover that Donnie has been killed. After the meeting turns into an ambush, the Kingfishers kidnap Lori, forcing Jason and Brian to pursue her captors by helicopter and boat.

places.name: Don Gone
places.desc: Following Donnie's death, Brian orders Jason to remove evidence of his involvement in their criminal operations. Jason visits Donnie's trailer, collects his belongings, and destroys his vehicle to make it appear that Donnie has left town.

places.name: Recalibration
places.desc: Concerned about Cal following Donnie's death, Jason and Lucia visit him to offer their support. The trio go fishing together before returning to Cal's house to prepare a meal.

places.name: Tourist Trap
places.desc: Jason and Lucia accept Mattia's offer of a well-paid job and travel to a visitor center to collect a bag from a locker. The assignment turns out to be a trap involving corrupt police officers. Jason is seriously injured during the confrontation, forcing Lucia to fight their way out and escape by boat.

places.name: Home Sweet Home
places.desc: With Jason receiving medical treatment, Lucia returns to their house in Key Lento to collect his belongings. She discovers intruders inside the property and must escape when the house catches fire, before evading a police search of the surrounding area.

places.name: Discharge Time
places.desc: Lucia travels to a hospital in Vice City to reunite with Jason, but the pair are attacked by armed men pursuing them. They fight their way out of the hospital and escape toward Kelly County, bringing the first chapter to an end.
